name: OpenAudioBench
intro: OpenAudioBench 是 Baichuan-Audio 论文发布的音频理解基准，包含自建 Reasoning QA 202题、Spoken Llama Questions 300题、随机抽样的 Web Questions 1,000题与 TriviaQA 1,000题，以及经过子集筛选并移除数学和代码问题的 AlpacaEval 199题，共2,701题。评测分别覆盖语音转文本与非级联语音转语音设置。
build_method: 自建音频推理题, 公开问答子集抽样与筛选, 作者TTS语音合成
task_type: 开放式问答, 逻辑推理, 常识问答
eval_feature: 五个音频子集, 语音转文本与语音转语音, GPT-4o参考答案或开放式评分
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Logical Reasoning, Commonsense QA
build_method_en: Self-constructed Audio Reasoning, Public QA Subset Sampling and Filtering, Author TTS Speech Synthesis
eval_feature_en: Five Audio Components, Speech-to-text and Speech-to-speech, GPT-4o Reference-based or Open-ended Judging
intro_en: OpenAudioBench is the audio-understanding benchmark released with Baichuan-Audio. It contains 202 self-constructed Reasoning QA items, 300 Spoken Llama Questions, random samples of 1,000 Web Questions and 1,000 TriviaQA items, and 199 filtered AlpacaEval items after removing math and code questions, for 2,701 items total. Evaluation covers speech-to-text and non-cascaded speech-to-speech settings.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Section 4.3 of arXiv:2502.17239 and the official baichuan-inc/OpenAudioBench dataset card. The diagrams preserve Reasoning QA (202), Spoken Llama Questions (300), Web Questions (1,000), TriviaQA (1,000), and AlpacaEval (199); random sampling for Web Questions and TriviaQA; selection of helpful-base and vicuna AlpacaEval subsets with math and code removed; TTS synthesis reported for Web Questions, TriviaQA, and AlpacaEval prompts; the 2,701-item total; speech-to-text and non-cascaded speech-to-speech settings; merging interleaved output text for speech-to-speech evaluation; reference-based GPT-4o correctness judging for Reasoning, Llama, Web, and Trivia; and GPT-4o-based scoring for AlpacaEval.
